|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]] (version 3 of 4). The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); '''this page''' (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookiee Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Vader. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 7, slip 51. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 40). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=40, page 40. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=40 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “51” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “Wookiee” as “Wookie” (it also writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and runs “reshuffle.LOST” together, which is notation only): “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookie Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle.LOST: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”.<ref name="cl-1261_48-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-weaponlevitation&theempiresback-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]]) again, word for word: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookiee Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Vader. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “51” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 40)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back]]) again, word for word: “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookiee Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Vader. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-48-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “51”). The release-sheet slip and the PC card image show only the Weapon Levitation art; the Master List slip shows the two-card split art (Weapon Levitation and The Empire's Back). The release-sheet slip prints the title without the uniqueness dot; the PC card image and the Master List slip print “•Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back”.
